context: For an unresolved literal on an open item, check git log --all -1 -- <path>; existed-then-deleted becomes a finding ('references a deleted file'). Bound the git cost (one batched lookup per lint run, or cache per path). Do not lower the ratio cutoff.
description: Swept 2026-08-01: _project/scripts/todo_cli.py (6 open items) and _project/scripts/validate_todo.py (5 open items) both existed and were deleted in the G5 cutover (#1232); their difflib ratios to surviving siblings (0.74-0.76) sit below the 0.87 near-miss cutoff, interleaved with genuinely planned new files at the same ratios (test_databend_deployment_mode.py 0.76). No ratio cutoff separates the two populations; git history does exactly: a path that once existed and was deleted is a stale reference, not a plan.
